Adequately fun brunch foods, Pretty but not tasty drinks, Good location+atmos.
Sep 2025 • Family
Adequately fun brunch foods:
Pancakes, toasties, burgers and English muffins - many other places have these brunch items too but they've managed to elevate these staples with good quality cheeses, bacons and wagyu. Pastas were good too - the usually boring pesto pasta elsewhere is made more exciting here with edamame, chopped nuts, fresh pesto and feta all bursting in flavour and texture within each munch of the al dente rigatoni. The more old school among us tried their Special-of-month i.e. Bun Bo Hue and enjoyed the tender meats but it came at a heftier price of ~usd15.

Pretty but not tasty drinks:
Drinks looked pretty, coffee art game strong but coffee tasted diluted and... weird.

Good location and chill atmosphere:
One of those shops that preserved its traditional shophouse façade and twirly stairs within but modernized its interiors with comfy leather seats and marble table tops. Watch the world go by on their balcony facing the busy Le Loi road junction.

Great spot near shopping
Dec 2024 • Couples
“We stumbled upon this place by accident while feeling hungry, hot, and tired—and what a find! The atmosphere is clean and chic, with an upscale, western-style vibe. The drinks were outstanding—I had a caramel iced coffee that was absolutely delicious (and I’m not even a coffee drinker, so that’s saying something!).

As pescatarians, finding great options can be a challenge, but this spot was perfect. We ordered the miso salmon and a shrimp stir-fry dish, and both were fantastic—flavorful and beautifully prepared. The service was excellent, and the restaurant itself is super charming. Highly recommend!”
